Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 41 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Manoj - 42 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Manoj stand near him.]

Manoj: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rishabh feeds the dog.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

[Rishabh milks the cow.]

Pallavi (surprised): "Hmm, I see."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Rishabh: "Yes, all right."

[Rishabh pats his horse.]

Pallavi: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Pallavi and Manoj stand near him.]

Rishabh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh goes jogging in the park.]

Manoj (gently): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh catches the ball.]

Pallavi (gently): "Yes, all right."

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Rishabh stands in the kitchen. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Rishabh, look over here."

[Rishabh makes tea for everyone.]

Rishabh: "This is amazing!"

[Rishabh chops onions for the curry.]

Pallavi (softly): "One more time!"

[Rishabh washes the dishes after dinner.]

Rishabh (happily): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
